items.headline: Extreme Heat Warning issued October 3 at 9:40PM PDT until October 8 at 8:00PM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerously hot conditions with high temperatures ranging
from the mid 80s to low 90s at the beaches to the mid 90s to around
100 for inland coastal areas expected. Nights will be very warm
with low temperatures in the low to mid 70s.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM PDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Heat related illnesses increase significantly during
extreme heat events.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

Do not leave young children and pets in unattended vehicles. Car
interiors will reach lethal temperatures in a matter of minutes.
